text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I head to the venue for the Debut Selection Race. ...With every step
I take, the maracas I forgot to return yesterday rattle softly inside my bag.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, amore! I've been waiting for you! I have prepared
the finest seat in the house just for you. Come, take my hand.
choice_data_list: A-Ah, sure. I'm looking forward to watching you run.
Y-Yeah. I'm really looking forward to your race.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì! Naturally, I shall live up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
However, if possible, I hope you won't watch only me—
I want you to enjoy this once-in-a-lifetime session in its entirety.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: For I am not the only performer out there.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Listen closely, won't you?
What kind of sounds do you hear from those running alongside me?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: *deep inhale, exhale*... *deep inhale, exhale*... All right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deep, steadying breaths, voices psyching themselves up, anxious footsteps...
All kinds of sounds drift over from the girls waiting on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What resonates from them is impatience, nervous tension, anticipation—
and above all, a fierce determination to be the one who claims victory.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Benissimo! It seems you can hear their sound as well.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What will happen when all these sounds intertwine?
Look forward to the curtain rising!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: The Debut Selection Race, 1800 meters on turf... and they're off with a clean start!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Forza, iniziamo la sessione!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because she guided me right to the front row, the horsegirls' heat washes directly
over me. —Horseshoes digging into turf. The thunderous roar vibrates against my eardrums.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Take the lead early...! I won't let anyone past me!
Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Look at that! Number 5 breaks out with a brilliant start!
A fierce battle for the front, and she takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu, so that is your tempo giusto.
In that case, I shall answer with affrettando...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth is running splendidly as well, chasing down the front-runner.
A fierce clash for position unfolds. ...I can feel the rumble right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Number 4 swings to the outside! She's gunning for the front!
Inch by inch, she closes the gap on the leader!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thud-thud-thud-thud! Footsteps echo as ragged breaths fill the air.
I can see their fierce expressions clearly. —My chest tightens with burning excitement.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose...! Because...
I have a dream too—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thud-thud-thud-thud! Rumble-rumble-rumble! It's like an oncoming avalanche.
The sound the horsegirls make crashes against the stands like a tidal wave...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
They're rounding the final turn!
Number 5 is losing ground slightly! Can she hold the lead to the end?!
choice_data_list: I see... This is what she meant by a session...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each horsegirl is delivering her own performance—her own musical piece. As a result,
their unrestrained rhythms collide, creating a once-in-a-lifetime harmony.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in the middle of it all, everyone is aiming for that single moment—to take the lead.
To seize the main melody of the piece and overwhelm everything around them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was the world that captured my heart in the first place. A pure, unadulterated
clash of all-out effort. A heartfelt contest that moves anyone watching to tears!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because I loved races like this, I chose the path of a Trainer.
Just so I could support them as they poured everything into running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course winning and losing matters. But by getting
obsessed with that, I lost sight of what was truly important—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The first thing to consider is the girls themselves.
How a horsegirl wants to run. Listening to and honoring her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even so... winning is what truly counts."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's not wrong. But that isn't everything!
Because... what I truly wanted to do was...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*—Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Brillllante! What a magnificent race!
Each of them playing their finest tune, clashing together into glorious musica!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, this is the very session I have longed for... That is why,
volti subito! With every ounce of my performance, show them who I am!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(I don't need to be the soloist. —Yet, I must answer this call.
To prove that I am a horsegirl worthy of standing shoulder to shoulder with them!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(For this session! For this musica!
Give them a worthy esultazione!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*! Haaaaaaaahhhh!
choice_data_list: Let your melody ring out! Earthhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Ahaha! I hear it!
I hear you loud and clear, agnellino!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (—Your sound!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(A vibrato hoarse with pure excitement! And that is why it is so beautiful!
An indispensable, precious chord in this grand session!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Now, the stage is set! At this very moment, let it resonate across the world—
no, across the entire Earth!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (The session we will play together!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I was struck by how innocently she ran. She surely knew
a joy in racing that went beyond mere winning and losing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because no matter the outcome—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she could smile like that, she was already victorious.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I have returned, my amore. Alas, second place.
Did I fail to live up to your expectations?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so? Then I am glad.
Getting those concert tickets was well worth it, then.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Your melodia has shifted. From doloroso to animato.
Did something wonderful happen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod slowly at her words. Taking a deep breath,
I look Sounds of Earth straight in the eye—
choice_data_list: I found the horsegirl I want to scout.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And tell her just that.
